    """

    :param tick_rate_hz: Tick rate in Hz.

    try:

            await motor.update()
            await async_lib.sleep(record_interval_s)
            await motor.record()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(e)
    finally:
        await motor.stop()
        async_lib.stop()
